kernel_witness_check.proof_type:
((∀ (l : NNReal), 0 < l → ∃ x, w l ↑x ↑(T x) < ⊤) → ∃ x, T x = x) ∧
  ((∀ (l : NNReal), 0 < l → ∀ (x y : { x // ∃ m, 0 < m ∧ w m x b < ⊤ }), w l ↑x ↑y < ⊤) →
    ∃ xstar,
      T xstar = xstar ∧
        (∀ (y : { x // ∃ l, 0 < l ∧ w l x b < ⊤ }), T y = y → y = xstar) ∧
          ∀ (x : { x // ∃ l, 0 < l ∧ w l x b < ⊤ }),
            ∃ l, 0 < l ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => w l ↑(T^[n] x) ↑xstar) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
